pr.title: Parse telemetry packets of version 2
pr.description: Devices with firmware 4.x send version 2 packets: a 2-byte sample count, a label, and a CRC-16 at the end. This adds `parseV2`, the CRC, a protocol page, and tests. Version 1 parsing does not change.

bugs.note: Off-by-one: a label of exactly 32 bytes passes the > check, and the NUL goes to label[32], one byte past the field. The length comes from the network.
Unchecked error: the result of r.u16(crc) is ignored. A packet that ends before the checksum compares an uninitialized value.

traps.why: size - 4 looks like it can wrap, but the kMinV2Size check on the line before makes size at least 12.
Style only: the casts are noisy, but they keep the integer promotion of uint16_t explicit and the values are right.
